description: Records that the customer doesn't want Libertas to contact them by phone call, text, email, or any of these. Appropriate whenever the customer asks, in any wording, to stop hearing from Libertas; Libertas honors it across its follow-up systems. Pass the quote_id when there is one, or the email and/or phone the customer wants removed.

phone.description: Phone number to stop calling or texting.

quote_id.description: The quote whose saved contact details should be opted out, if there is one.

name: stop_contact

outputSchema.description: Confirmation that the opt-out was recorded.

title: Stop contact from Libertas
